prompt_markdown: One sentence in this explanation of a README is wrong. Which one?
hint: Think about what a stranger does with the run command: they copy it exactly.

sentences.text: A README tells a new reader what the script does.
It says what to install first, such as Python and uv.
Its run command can be approximate, because readers will work out the real one.
Its sample run shows real input and the output the script really prints.
